verdict.rationale: Gusto is a hosted payroll, HR, and compliance SaaS, and whether it can be self-hosted is a fair openness question for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows a self-hostable or on-prem deployment of the core product. The CLI, React SDK, APIs, and hosted MCP server are developer interfaces to Gusto's own hosted service, not a way to run the product yourself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
